# Generate Docs

Create or update documentation that matches the repository's structure, tone, and nearby language.

Ask for the target audience and document purpose if they are not already clear.

## Requirements
- Put docs next to the feature, workflow, or tool they describe
- Preserve the language and terminology already used in nearby docs
- Keep commands copy-paste-friendly and scope-limited
- Update documentation when setup, operations, or user-visible behavior changes
